content.block.armor.title: Armor
content.block.armor.desc: Modular armor with better resistances and an equipment grid.
content.block.gun.title: Gun and ammo
content.block.gun.desc: A faster submachine gun and magazines with more damage.
content.block.grenade.title: Grenade
content.block.grenade.desc: A grenade with twice the damage.
content.block.turret.title: Gun turret
content.block.turret.desc: More health and a longer range.
content.block.wall.title: Wall
content.block.wall.desc: A wall with twice the health.
content.block.enemy.title: Enemy
content.block.enemy.desc: A tougher, faster biter in its own colour, spawned by biter nests.
content.block.shield.title: Shield equipment
content.block.shield.desc: An energy shield for armor that holds more.
content.block.belt.title: Belt tier
content.block.belt.desc: Belt, underground belt and splitter, faster than express.
content.block.inserter.title: Inserter
content.block.pipe.title: Pipes
content.block.pipe.desc: A pipe that holds more and an underground pipe that reaches 20 tiles.
content.block.pole.title: Electric pole
content.block.pole.desc: A longer reach and a larger supply area.
content.block.assembler.title: Assembling machine
content.block.assembler.desc: A machine with a recipe category of its own and an example recipe.
content.block.furnace.title: Furnace
content.block.furnace.desc: Smelts 50 % faster than the steel furnace.
content.block.ore.title: Ore
content.block.ore.desc: A new ore placed on Nauvis, smelted into iron plates.
content.block.drill.title: Mining drill
content.block.drill.desc: Twice as fast, mining a 7x7 area.
content.block.solar.title: Solar power
content.block.solar.desc: A stronger solar panel and a bigger accumulator.
content.block.car.title: Car
content.block.car.desc: Tougher, stronger, with a bigger trunk.
content.block.train.title: Train
content.block.train.desc: A faster locomotive and a cargo wagon that holds more.
